turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Ansel, I got the quote, thank you. Will that battery still be big enough once the car arrives?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good question. On its own, probably not. I'd move you up to the 10 kWh battery. It costs £1,900 more, but it should cover your evenings and leave room for the car.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: OK, let's go with the bigger one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done, I've updated the quote: 4 kW array and a 10 kWh battery. Shall I book the installation?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please. Can the crew come at the usual time for me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. I've booked Thursday 15 October, and the crew will arrive at 1:30 pm, not their normal 8 am start.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect. I'll take Biscuit to my neighbour's for the day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. We'll message you the day before as a reminder.
